messages:
Ava: Weekend poll — rooftop brunch + plant pop-up on Sat morning or early sea swim + picnic at the cove? which are you up for? :sun_with_face::seedling:
Marcus: Rooftop brunch for me. coffee + avo toast :raised_hands:
Priya: Sea swim! low tide looks good and less crowded. can bring blankets and snacks 🏖️
Liam: I can do brunch but only if there's good coffee. any vegan options at the pop-up?
Ava: @Liam there’s a vendor called GreenBite, they do vegan quiches and oat lattes. menu link: https://example.com/greenbite-menu
Marcus: Also rooftop has decent shade. I can bring a portable speaker — chill playlist?
Priya: @Marcus yes please but low volume. and sunscreen. someone bring a spare towel?
Liam: I have an extra towel and a tiny bluetooth speaker. if we go to the cove I can bring a cooler with iced water.
Ava: Quick vote: reply with "brunch" or "swim"
Marcus: brunch
Priya: swim
Liam: brunch
Ava: tally so far: 2 brunch, 1 swim. still more time to change your mind :smile:
dev-bot: Reminder: Sat morning building roof access closes at 11:30am. If choosing rooftop, meet by 9:30 to get tables reserved.
Priya: oh good call @dev-bot — maybe meet at 8:30 for the swim then? earlier is better for waves.
Marcus: 9:30 rooftop works for me. can you DM me the exact lobby code, @Ava?
Ava: sending now. Also, if anyone wants to carpool, I have 2 seats from Mission — leaving 9:00.
Liam: I’ll take a seat if it’s brunch. thanks Ava!
Priya: I’ll pass on the carpool — I bike. meet you all either way :bike: 
Ava: final plan: keep both options open. if you said "brunch" meet by 9:30 at lobby; if "swim" we’ll meet 8:30 at the cove parking. I’ll post a short poll in the morning if anyone flips.
Marcus: sounds perfect. see you Saturday :sun_with_face:
Priya: see ya! :wave:
Liam: cya :thumbsup:
